in_english.name: Nurah
in_english.meaning: Light from Allah, radiant light, lunar light, celestial light, divine guidance, spiritual enlightenment, inner peace, and harmony
in_english.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'nur', meaning light, guidance, and illumination. It symbolizes the divine light that shines within every individual, guiding them towards righteousness and truth. In Islamic tradition, Nurah represents the blessings of Allah and the radiance of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). It is a name that embodies spiritual growth, wisdom, and the pursuit of knowledge. The name Nurah is often associated with qualities such as compassion, kindness, and generosity. In modern times, Nurah has become a popular name across Muslim cultures, symbolizing the light of guidance and the pursuit of excellence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nurah holds great significance in the Islamic world, as it is the name of one of Prophet Muhammad's favorite daughters. The prophet was once asked, "Which of you is the most beloved to me?" His response was "Fatima, our daughter, is the most beloved of all people to me." This hadith (sayings and actions of Prophet Muhammad) emphasizes the prominent place held for Nurah in Islamic history and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nurah holds deep spiritual significance in Islam. It represents the light of faith and belief in Allah. The love for Nurah and her virtues serves as an inspiration and reminder of the importance of leading a virtuous life and dissolving one's inner darkness with continuous spiritual development. Additionally, it is a reminder of the light that emanates from the practice of good deeds and the positive effect it has on not only oneself but those around.
